summary.en: Shout, and your voice bursts into comic-book onomatopoeia on screen — joined by QR, measured on-device, audio never leaves the phone.
summary.jp: 叫ぶと声が擬音になって画面に弾ける。QR で参加する VJ で、音声は端末から出ない。

mine: Designed a voice-triggered VJ that turns shouts into on-screen onomatopoeia
Built on-device audio measurement so no audio ever leaves the phone
Built the QR-join Snap Pair flow and canvas rendering
